project_type: Django REST API backend + React/Vite/TanStack Router frontend (monorepo-style, two separate directories)
build_system: Django manage.py (backend); Vite + pnpm (frontend). Frontend lives at frontend/src/frontend/, backend at Backend/.
test_framework: No backend unit tests for views; Django system check is used for correctness. Frontend: vitest (pnpm run test), TypeScript check: pnpm run typecheck.
build_command: Backend: none needed for plan verification. Frontend: pnpm run build (from frontend/src/frontend/).
test_command: Backend check: $env:ENDPOINT_SENTINEL_ENV_FILE='.env.development'; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check  (run from Backend/). Frontend typecheck: pnpm run typecheck  (run from frontend/src/frontend/).
verification_instructions: 1. From c:\Projects\Endpoint-Sentinel\Endpoint-Sentinel\Backend: Set-Location Backend; $env:ENDPOINT_SENTINEL_ENV_FILE='.env.development'; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check  — expect 'System check identified no issues (0 silenced).' 2. From c:\Projects\Endpoint-Sentinel\Endpoint-Sentinel\frontend\src\frontend: pnpm run typecheck  — expect exit 0 with no errors.
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell. Use PowerShell syntax for all shell commands. Backend venv is at Backend/venv/. Never use 'requests' library in backend — urllib.request only. Do not touch existing dashboard/endpoint pages.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns exactly. Do not modify existing views, routes, or sidebar items — only add new ones. Use TokenAuthentication + IsAuthenticated on all new API views.
key_patterns: Backend views: @api_view(['GET']) + @authentication_classes([TokenAuthentication]) + @permission_classes([IsAuthenticated]) + return Response({...}). Settings: config('KEY', default='') via python-decouple. URLs: added to dashboard/urls.py with path(...) entries. Frontend routes: createRoute({getParentRoute: () => rootRoute, path: '/...', component: Page}) assembled into rootRoute.addChildren([...]). Sidebar: NAV_ITEMS array of {label, to, icon}. API calls: this.request('/api/...') inside APIClient class. Types: interfaces exported from lib/types.ts.
directory_structure: Backend/ — Django project root with manage.py, venv/, core/ (settings.py, urls.py), dashboard/ (api_views.py, urls.py, models.py, views.py, auth_api.py, licensing_api.py, views_realtime_monitoring.py). frontend/src/frontend/ — Vite/React app with src/pages/, src/components/ (Sidebar.tsx, Layout.tsx), src/lib/ (api-client.ts, types.ts, format.ts, auth.ts, useAuth.ts, useEndpoints.ts). .agents/tasks/ — plan and FEAT artifact files (outside the worktree for commits).
